title: Compile logical Fourfold retrieval onto BM25 and typed relation indices
dependencies: the bounded Tensor/Fourfold reference contracts present at base_revision
primary_claim: The Fourfold/Tensor layer should express typed multi-relation query semantics and compile onto ordinary physical indices; BM25 supplies lexical seeds rather than being replaced by a flattened tensor score.

design.physical_layer: deterministic forward/reverse adjacency indices over TypedRelationBlock
design.seed_layer: existing pure-stdlib s07 BM25 plus exact identity token matches

contracts.authority: The design and authority_boundary objects in this packet are frozen: KnowledgeForest and FourfoldSnapshot remain authoritative and retrieval output remains proposal-only.
contracts.compatibility: The logical layer compiles onto deterministic adjacency indices while the existing pure-stdlib BM25 implementation remains the lexical seed path.
contracts.refusal: Revision or Forest-digest mismatches refuse compilation; no result may mutate authority or promote itself.

acceptance: compiler refuses a FourfoldSnapshot whose source_forest_sha256 differs
compiler preserves multiple targets for one source without dictionary overwrite
every block binds repository, revision, Forest digest and Fourfold digest
logical multi-hop intersection returns only targets reached by every branch
physical planner names adjacency lookup, sparse hash join and set combination
evidence digests survive every relation hop and appear in result receipts
BM25 supplies start-plane seeds and direct target-plane candidates
graph expansion can rerank a structurally supported target above a lexical decoy
all outputs remain proposal-only and cannot promote or mutate authority

verification.author_side_smoke: API-compatible local stubs: py_compile succeeded; focused tests 5 passed. This is not exact-head repository evidence.

evidence.status: author-side smoke only; exact-head repository evidence remains required
evidence.retained_negative_conditions: The kill_or_redesign array remains authoritative negative evidence and stop criteria.
evidence.admissible_evidence: Only the requested exact-head compile and pytest runs may support the primary claim.

expected_failures: A source Forest digest mismatch refuses compilation.
Any gain explained entirely by extra context, or matched by a simpler deterministic relation-index query, triggers redesign under kill_or_redesign.
No benchmark-superiority, merge, promotion or gate-transition claim is admissible.
review_questions: Are logical query semantics kept separate from the physical BM25 and adjacency indices?
Does every result retain revision, Forest, Fourfold and evidence-digest bindings?
Can any output escape proposal-only status or reach promotion authority?
kill_or_redesign: hybrid does not improve evidence recall or agent task success over BM25 plus four indices
gain disappears when graph paths are permuted or evidence is removed
gain is explained entirely by more retrieved context
construction or update cost has no repeated-query break-even
a simpler deterministic relation-index query produces equivalent outputs and costs
migration: No production contract or persistent state is migrated; this remains an isolated experiment package.
rollback: Delete the isolated experiment package, focused test, workflow and this Work Packet; no production contract or persistent state is changed.
